Township of West Lincoln

8.  Roads Network 
The Township’s road network comprises the largest share of its infrastructure portfolio, with a 
current replacement cost of more than $156 million, belonging primarily to paved roads. The 
Township also owns and manages other supporting infrastructure and capital assets, including 
sidewalks, streetlights, signs, roadside barriers, and gravel roads. 
8.1 Inventory & Valuation 
Table 26 summarizes the quantity and current replacement cost of the Township’s various road 
network assets as managed in its primary asset management register, Citywide.
